name: custtoolset_pillar5_extractor
description: Extracts NetSuite integration metrics, evaluating API latency, concurrent thread pool limits, and payload rejection rates (e.g., HTTP 429 errors).

analysisType.description: The integration metric to analyze. Use 'api_throughput' for rate limits/429 errors, 'endpoint_latency' for slow RESTlets (>3s), or 'concurrency_thresholds' for parallel request thread monitoring.

returns.description: A JSON payload detailing middleware integration bottlenecks, endpoint processing times, and concurrency limit breaches.
